## Hi there 👋

I'm a second-year BEng Computer Science student at Anglia Ruskin University in Cambridge. I enjoy building things to understand them better, and I'm currently focused on learning how computers work at a lower level, particularly through systems programming, computer architecture, and embedded computing.

## On the workbench 🔧

- [**Murmur:**](https://github.com/george-cliff/murmur) Exploring offline bird call detection using machine learning on low powered hardware, aimed at remote areas where Wi-Fi or mobile data may not be available.
- [**Triarch:**](https://github.com/george-cliff/triarch-compute-sim) Comparing C, C++, and Rust emulators of a RISC-V processor for performance and verifying them against a SystemVerilog hardware model, with Python coordinating the experiments and GPU modelling to follow.
- [**Atlas:**](https://github.com/george-cliff/atlas-homelab) A Linux home server built from salvaged PC parts, running self-hosted services.

## Contact me 📬

I'm excited to put what I've been learning into practice through an internship, contribute to open-source projects, and learn from other developers. I'm always happy to chat, so if you'd like to learn more about me or get in touch, you can visit my website, read my CV, find me on LinkedIn, or send me an email using the buttons below.
